answers.text: Refuter: 'Not near its high: W 14.0% under the 20-wk high.' My test is C5/C19: a new high clearing the prior Pivotal Point. D is HH/HL 1.2% under its 20-day high, but W dist_to_20bar_high_pct 14.0 with swing LH but HL means the daily lift is a Natural Rally inside a larger reaction, not a resumed Upward Trend. That is evidence my method cares about. Conceded; I stand aside until it clears the weekly high.

Refuter: 'D 21.6% above the last swing high: chase zone.' My test (C5, C16) is whether it sits at its own recent high, not distance from an old pivot: D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 2.4, W 2.4% under its 20-wk high, D swing HH/HL. Buying the new high is the sound act; regretting the lower entry is the error. H1 LH/LL at 52% of range is a minor swing my formula filters out (C21). Not conceded.

Refuter: 'D 7.0% under the 20-day high: turned off its top.' Climax is not my test. On my grid D is HH/HL with dist_to_20bar_high_pct 7.0: that is the normal reaction inside the trend, which is why my blind trigger was already the new high, not today. My claim was the trend, and W HH/HL still shows it. Not conceded; I act only when it clears the high (C5).
